title: A4-R4-F1: start_effect duration and durationOverride input descriptions state false typed-only boundaries
description: Re-audit R4 (eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.17) blocker, verified by Captain at 9106487d. Same class as A4-F1 (ADR 0020 Decision 3, design 5.9 condition 6), sibling exposed by the expanded query; predates #712/#714. toolStartEffect.ts:181 duration description says it is required except for a typed item effect, but a next-dawn item grant (Bag of Tricks) may omit it and the engine computes the minutes (toolStartEffect.ts ~645-668). :186 durationOverride description says declare only when overriding a typed item duration, but any magic-item source accepts it: typed changes the duration, untyped item power/grant records an unbound dm-override (:672-695); refused for next-dawn grants and for non-magic-item sources (whose error message at ~:640 also says 'typed item duration'). Runtime is correct; descriptions are wrong.
acceptance_criteria:
- The start_effect duration and durationOverride input descriptions, and the non-item-source refusal message, state exactly the engine's cases (typed item effect omission, next-dawn grant computed omission, override on any magic-item source except next-dawn grants, ruleId only on the typed path, refusal for non-item sources); runtime unchanged.
- Reviewed declaration assertions protect the corrected descriptions; existing behaviour tests still pass.
close_reason: Merged PR #718 (1f48027344197f8b73ad748a1a24610002e8c0ca) after clean Sol review .18.1
